title: pinalia biglandulosa
intro: Pinalia biglandulosa, commonly known as the Pala Katira, is a type of flowering plant native to the tropical forests of Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to support respiratory health, boost the immune system, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Pinalia biglandulosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
